title: Big Questions on Software Architecture: Report of the ICSE 2026 BoF on Software Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2609.04212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software Architecture (SA) is more important than ever, from the need to master the pervasive impact of technology in society and planet earth, to balancing the role of humans versus technology, flexibility versus chaos, economic convenience versus digital autonomy. Despite SA importance, we feel that the SA research community needs to reflect on what are the big questions that deserve scientific research, and what are instead technology trends or hypes. In this paper, we report the results of a community initiative aiming to identify and discuss the big questions in SA research. Organised in two sessions hosted in 2026 at the ICSE and ICSA conferences, respectively, this paper reports on the results collected during the first session, and looks forward to complementing them with the results of the second one. To be continued ...

translated_title: 软件架构的重大问题：ICSE 2026软件架构 Birds-of-a-Feather 会议报告
translated_abstract: 软件架构（SA）比以往任何时候都更加重要，从掌握技术对社会和地球的普遍影响，到平衡人类与技术、灵活性与混乱、经济便利与数字自主之间的关系。尽管软件架构非常重要，我们认为软件架构研究界需要反思哪些是值得科学研究的大问题，哪些只是技术趋势或炒作。本文报告了一项社区倡议的结果，该倡议旨在识别和讨论软件架构研究中的重大问题。该倡议由2026年分别在ICSE和ICSA会议上举办的两次会议组成，本文报告了第一次会议收集的结果，并期待用第二次会议的结果对其进行补充。未完待续……
tldr: 本文报告了ICSE 2026软件架构BoF社区会议的结果，旨在识别和讨论软件架构研究领域值得科学研究的重大问题，以区分真正的研究方向与技术趋势或炒作。
en_tdlr: This paper reports the results of the ICSE 2026 BoF session on Software Architecture, aiming to identify and discuss the big questions in SA research that deserve scientific investigation, distinguishing genuine research directions from technology trends or hypes.
